approved_scope.category_description: rinse-out intensive masks/Haarkuren (Maske, Kur, Intensivkur, Express-Kur, Bond-Kur, Gloss-/Laminier-Kur) applied after cleansing with a product-stated contact time and rinsed out; multi-use products mode-scoped

locked_interpretation.care_direction: Product formula direction only; never a diagnosis of a user's protein or moisture state (D6, G6). Always populated for an in-category record; `balanced` carries two readings — (a) substantive mixed protein-plus-moisture architecture, (b) neither-dominant film-led architecture (R6, E9, E15) — and is never an uncertainty bucket. `unknown` only under a G5 / §2.4.1 tier-2 conflict.
locked_interpretation.repair_support_level: Comparative temporary damage-support potential only; no value proves structural repair. `high` is gated on a deterministic named bond route above the tail; 'Bond'/'Plex' naming, citric acid and hydrolysed protein never qualify.
locked_interpretation.conditioning_level: D1: the `concentration` twin — conditioning/treatment intensity relative to the mask shelf from structural INCI position only; extremes need multiple independent signals (R3, E1).
locked_interpretation.repair_headline: E16: the `repair` primary focus needs a qualifying bond route or a label-strong protein route (≥ 2 distinct qualifying hydrolysates or one quaternized protein derivative above the marker).
locked_interpretation.dwell: Contact time is protocol metadata under TPL-MASK/P5 and earns zero classification credit; the 7-second segment is `dwell_efficacy: unknown`.
locked_interpretation.conservative_failure_invariant: §1.1: every hard rule must fail toward human review or toward the anchor's own conservative value, never toward a recommendation or a more favourable reading than the evidence supports.
locked_interpretation.evidence_ceiling: Formula-only conclusions remain E2 and cannot establish finished-product performance. Claims are E0 and never create efficacy.
locked_interpretation.research_uncertainty: Confidence, evidence levels, counter-signals and reading conventions stay inside the research record and never reach a projected field or a user-facing surface.

validation_basis.promotion_note: v1.0 promotes the v0.6 draft unchanged. No anchor, threshold, enumeration, gate, projection, evidence bar, review trigger or string was edited; only the header block and a Version section were added.

known_limits_retained: E15 / `balanced` reading (b) is validated on exactly one product (u3 John Frieda Wunder-Kur); round 2.5 surfaced no second natural reading-(b) candidate.

Independence caveat: the standard's own ruling notes (E2/E7/E10/E11/E12 annotations) name several cohort products and outcomes, so the cohort rerun on those fields is confirmation-grade rather than perfectly blind; the unseen set and round 2.5 compensate (round-2 report §1).

G0 stops are first-class outcomes: `insufficient_information` (q3 Syoss Intense Repair — no rinse text in the exact-product source) is an evidence stop routed to a fresh capture, and the charter exclusions (#13, u5, u6) carry no profile. Neither is a failure of the engine.
The `maleate` and `peptide` bond-route branches remain untested in-category (maleate seen only as boundary evidence on excluded Olaplex records).
The tail-marker rank convention is a reading convention, never a measurement; EU Art. 19 hides the 1 % line, which is why boundary-position species cap confidence (E1).
Every §18 open question stays open under v1.0.
The evidence lexicon's own header still reads its pre-freeze draft status (v0.2, 'Not ruled'); it is frozen unchanged and pinned by the adapter.
